DATABASE SCHEMA (nb_works table)** **File**: `/c/Users/edn_y/renew_nineonelabs/database/works_migration.sql` **Key columns**: - `id` - Work item ID (primary) - `title` - Work title - `sub_title` - Subtitle (optional) - `thumb_image` - **PRIMARY THUMBNAIL** (filename only, stored in `/uploads/works/`) - `video` - **THUMBNAIL VIDEO** (JSON-encoded, can be string or array) - `client` - Client name - `category` - **JSON array of category IDs** (e.g., `[1,5]`) - `tag` - **JSON array of tag strings** - `services` - **JSON array of service type IDs** (e.g., `[1,5]`) - `link_url` - External website link - `overview` - Short description text - `contents` - Rich HTML content - `file_attach1` to `file_attach5` - **DETAIL IMAGES** (5 additional images) - `is_awarded` - Award flag (Y/N) - `award_type` - Award type ID - `award_detail` - Award detail text - `is_visible` - Visibility flag (1=visible) - `sort_no` - Sort order - `created_at`, `updated_at` - Timestamps --- ### **2. PHP API LAYER** **File**: `/c/Users/edn_y/renew_nineonelabs/api/works.php` **Main class**: `worksData` (singleton) **Key functions exported**: - `get_works_categories()` - Returns array of category slugs/labels - `get_works_list(offset, limit, category)` - Returns paginated works for grid/scatter - `get_work_detail(no)` - Returns full work detail with all fields - `get_works_public_count()` - Total visible works count - `get_works_award_page_rows()` - Awards page data **Important detail**: Videos are decoded from JSON via `resolveVideoUrl()` method - supports both single string and array format, returns first valid URL. **Field mappings in API response**: - `thumbnailImage` → `/uploads/works/{thumb_image}` or fallback to first detail image or placeholder - `thumbnailVideo` → decoded from `video` JSON field - `category`, `categoryLabel` → resolved from category JSON array (uses first as primary) - `services`, `tagLabels` → decoded from JSON arrays - `detailImages` → array of `file_attach1-5` (5 image fields) - `award` → object with `label`, `icon`, `detail` fields (only if `is_awarded=Y`) --- ### **3.
